=== METHOD ===
The second full one-hour soak, run with the banked Z-056 harness exactly as designed: run_z056.sh start hidden_files/z061_soak 3600 60, detached (setsid + nohup), launched by the previous team-01 lead at 11:16:59 EST (2026-11-12T16:16:59Z). Both legs ran the full 3600 s concurrently, pinned mimir -c 2 / glibc -c 3, sampling every 60 s plus t=0 and the deadline: 61 scheduled samples per leg (t = 0, 60, ..., 3600). Workload, sampling and integrity checks are as specified in the Z-056 recorded run: 320-slot mixed lifecycle, fixed-seed distribution 55% small (16..1024 B) / 25% medium (4 KiB..64 KiB) / 20% large (128 KiB..2 MiB), dense-touch, per-sample stored-byte verification of every live block (first/middle/last), calloc zero-fill and realloc contents-preservation verified, smaps_rollup Rss/Pss plus maps VMA and allocation-window hole reads per sample, timed latency batches (256 x 64 B + 32 x 64 KiB alloc/free); after the deadline each probe frees everything and emits DRAINED and DONE. Time-boxed, not op-boxed: the legs share duration and workload distribution, not the operation sequence, so per-leg drift curves are comparable as resident-shape series, never as equal-work measurements. Collect: run_z056.sh collect hidden_files/z061_soak verified both exit codes (0 and 0) and ran the summariser; collect exit 0. Raw files: hidden_files/z061_soak/z056_mimir.raw and z056_glibc.raw (team-local), appended verbatim below; both .err files are empty (0 bytes).

=== READING - SOAK 2, CURVE-BY-CURVE AGAINST Z-057 (roadmap gate) ===
Gate: soak report with the curve-by-curve comparison verdict vs Z-057 - MET. Both legs COMPLETE: 61 of 61 scheduled samples each (t = 0, 60, ..., 3600), DRAINED + DONE present, both probes exited 0, both .err files empty, summariser verdict ALL LEGS COMPLETE, collect exit 0. The full per-sample series for both legs is in the SUMMARY above and the RAW appendix below. All Z-057 figures quoted below are from the banked tests/perf/recorded_run_z13_z057.txt. The drift test is IDENTICAL for both runs: median Rss over the first 30 live samples vs the median over the last 30 live samples (live = t > 0). Worsts are quoted with the whole-hour medians and the t at which each worst occurs; worsts occur at different t and are not one snapshot.

F1 - Drift over the hour (the soak question), Z-061 vs Z-057. mimir: first-30 median 146,888 KiB vs last-30 median 149,122 KiB (+1.5%) - flat, NO upward drift. Z-057 mimir: 151,822 -> 148,730 KiB (-2.0%) - also flat. glibc: 188,526 -> 188,972 KiB (+0.2%) - flat; Z-057 glibc: 190,914 -> 187,950 KiB - also flat. VERDICT: TIE on drift - neither run drifts; the improved allocator holds the Z-057 no-drift result at the same duration. mimir final live sample 144,360 KiB sits below its hour median (summariser 147,868 KiB), and peak Rss (168,968 KiB) occurs mid-hour at t=1200, not at the tail (Z-057: final 133,816, peak 179,672 at t=720).
F2 - Resident shape. mimir net_factor median 1.948 / worst 2.515 (worst at t=3240) vs Z-057 1.988 / 2.469 (worst at t=1320); glibc net_factor median 2.637 / worst 3.357 (worst at t=3120) vs Z-057 2.500 / 3.168. Peak Rss mimir 168,968 KiB (t=1200) vs glibc 196,964 KiB (t=960), on live-byte peaks 95,730,553 B (t=1260) vs 93,119,314 B (t=2220); Z-057 peaks were 179,672 vs 204,084 KiB. Grade in roadmap words for the soak workload: WIN on resident shape (this workload, this machine, this shared-host window) - the Z-057 WIN holds, with mimir net median marginally better than Z-057 (1.948 vs 1.988) and glibc marginally worse (2.637 vs 2.500); the mimir-vs-glibc gap is unchanged in shape.
F3 - Worst fragmentation (mimir allocation-VMA window). Median 106 holes carrying a median 48,533,504 hole bytes at live samples (Z-057: median 108 / 52,664,320). Worst total hole bytes 77,832,192 B at t=2700 (Z-057: 76,947,456 B at t=2280); worst hole count 122 at t=2280 (Z-057: 123); worst single largest hole 21,606,400 B at t=2760 (Z-057: 24,289,280 B). VERDICT: TIE - the fragmentation curve is the Z-057 curve within run-to-run variation; no fragmentation regression and no fragmentation improvement is claimed. glibc's window shows 0 holes at every sample in both runs - its cost appears as the higher net_factor of F2.
F4 - Tail RSS and drain retention. mimir final live sample Rss 144,360 KiB; after freeing all 320 blocks in-process, DRAINED Rss 38,992 KiB (retained net 36,872 KiB over the t=0 baseline of 2,120 KiB, vma_delta +78) - essentially identical to Z-057 (DRAINED 38,772 KiB, retained net 36,696 KiB, vma_delta +73) and to the 600 s pilot posture: retention does NOT grow with duration and did not change between the two soaks. glibc DRAINED Rss 195,972 KiB equals its final live sample (retained net 193,884 KiB, vma_delta 0; Z-057: 186,480 / 184,392 / 0) - in-process arena/top retention, returned at exit. Process exit returns everything for both legs.
F5 - Throughput and latency (shared-machine samples, NOT baselines; throughput legs are time-boxed, NOT equal-work). glibc executed 1,598,629,888 ops vs mimir 253,541,376 in the same hour (6.30x; Z-057: 1,628,749,056 vs 256,120,832, 6.36x; mimir ops -1.0% vs Z-057, within shared-host variation - no throughput change is claimed). Latency verdicts on medians/shape only: batches flat all hour with no degradation trend in either run; small median 241 ns/op mimir (worst sample 456 at t=840) vs 45 glibc (worst 103 at t=840); large median 2,253 mimir (worst 5,191 at t=840) vs 143 glibc (worst 311 at t=840). Z-057 medians: small 253 vs 44, large 2,423 vs 134. VERDICT: LOSS on batch latency, same shape as Z-057 and the pilot; the t=840 worsts in both legs coincide with a shared-host contention moment and are recorded as such, not as allocator events.
F6 - Integrity. Neither leg aborted. Every sample of both legs verified the stored bytes of all live blocks (first/middle/last), every calloc fill verified zeroed, every realloc verified contents-preserved - 61 samples x 2 legs with zero mismatches; both probes exited 0 and both .err files are empty. No allocator bug was discovered by the soak, and no bug in this slice's tooling was found (the harness ran exactly as banked at Z-056).
OVERALL VERDICT vs Z-057: the improved allocator (banked Z-001..Z-060) reproduces the Z-057 soak curves curve-by-curve - no drift (TIE), resident-shape WIN vs glibc holds, fragmentation TIE, drain retention unchanged, batch latency LOSS vs glibc unchanged in shape. No regression introduced by the Wave 7 slices banked between the two soaks is visible in any curve, and no improvement is claimed beyond the marginally lower mimir net_factor median.
Team structure: the soak was launched by the previous team-01 lead (stopped mid-slice with the soak detached and healthy).
